generation.note: Event/property filters only reduce output. MEM needs mem; LEAKS needs leaks and checkpoints; plans need plansql; DBMS lock annotations need dbmslocks.

plans-disagreement.note: [doc] PostgreSQL methodology restricts plansql to test/development servers. [article: Dmitry Yukhtimovsky] and [article: Nikolay Kuznetsov] older profiles collect plans with slow SQL. Preserve both recommendations and dates (2017 / 2024-2026); do not call plans cheap permanent monitoring.

units-disagreement.note: [article: badcasedaily / OTUS] uses Dur; not documented as equivalent to duration/durationus. [article: Konstmax13] corrected filter units on 2026-10-23. Generate durationus, never Dur. [doc] Historical 8.1 used ten-thousandths of a second; exact transition remains [unverified].

invalid-examples.note: [article: Nikolay Kuznetsov] includes a leading space in SDBL and system nested under log. Documented token is SDBL; system belongs under config.

disk-not-network.note: CALL InBytes/OutBytes are disk I/O despite contrary article interpretations. VRS Body is the request/response body size in bytes, not the body text.

absence.note: Absent does not mean healthy: disabled event, duration filtering, generation settings, missing node, active unfinished call and version can all explain absence.

identities.note: [unverified] Correlation must scope node, process, infobase and interval. Equal numbers across SessionID, t:connectID, ClientID and dbpid do not link identities.

nested-time.note: [unverified] Use union of child intervals for residual time; summing nested durations double counts. Residual time is unexplained by captured events, not proven BSL CPU.

ibsrv.note: [article: Autumn Library] observed file-mode code without CALL and ibsrv CALL depth 0 without t:clientID on macOS 8.3.27. Generality on Windows/Linux and other releases is [unverified]. Never assume only rphost directories.

file-lock-matrix.note: [unverified] No sufficient basis for asserting TLOCK/TTIMEOUT/TDEADLOCK never occur in every file, web and ibsrv mode. Verify each mode/version.

cost.note: No universal MB/day, negligible-overhead, memory, row or process-count thresholds are established. Filters reduce recorded volume, not necessarily instrumentation cost. More than 20 log elements is discouraged.

retention.note: history is hours; 0 disables automatic deletion, not logging. rotationsize is MB per file, not a total directory cap. Gilev short 2-hour, IBS week and analytic long-retention advice serve different tasks.

versions.note: JSON/placement/new rotation arrived in 8.3.25. CALL memory/I/O expanded in 8.3.5; CpuTime in 8.3.13. 8.5.1 filter-unit confirmation does not prove every property unchanged.

source-access.note: ITS lock and deadlock methodologies were available as indexed excerpts (direct 403); gilev.ru pages via index (redirect loops); Burmistrov via index (429); PGConf PDF text only, XML images not transcribed. Books and 2012 attachments were not read; no claims from their unseen contents.

json-unknowns.note: [unverified] Duplicate keys and malformed property names need real-corpus verification. This parser rejects duplicate case-insensitive keys rather than repairing semantics. Unknown event kinds remain readable.

causality.note: [unverified] Keep fact, diagnostic hypothesis, missing evidence and recommendation separate. lka/lkp proves observed blocking, not a deadlock cycle. Carrier event may not be the resource-acquiring SQL.

service-account.note: A service-account cluster does not read the interactive user LOCALAPPDATA. Configuration lookup: version bin/conf, user LOCALAPPDATA/1C/1cv8/conf, ConfLocation, ALLUSERSPROFILE/1C/1cv8/conf. Earlier files shadow later ones.

capture-window.note: Scenario is a short manual bounded reproduction: start, reproduce once, stop immediately; history is retention, not automatic capture expiry.

plans-execution.note: EXPLAIN ANALYZE really executes SQL. Do not automatically replay data-changing statements. Reproduce platform connection settings; historic SET lists are not current universal defaults.

instrumentation.note: mem, leaks, scriptcircrefs, query NULL validation and sessiondatacontext add overhead. Full Windows dumps can be large; history does not delete dumps. Linux/macOS dumps use OS facilities.

methodology-scope.note: [doc] Classify whether the slowdown affects all users, one user, the whole system or one function; reproduce on comparable problem-user data. PostgreSQL methodology uses DB time share around 50 percent as a reason to inspect SQL, not a universal failure boundary. [unverified] Nested interval overlap must be removed before interpreting ratios. Use full-user-operation timing, including form serialization/client work outside the BSL timer.

log.meaning: JSON/plain dedicated location, retention hours and size rotation MB.
log.reason: Separate capture ownership and JSON parser compatibility.
log.cost: Size rotation does not cap total disk usage.

event.meaning: OR between event branches, AND between predicates in a branch.
event.reason: Collect selected profile events; filters only reduce generated data.
event.cost: Volume depends on event frequency; no fixed overhead guarantee.

property.meaning: all retains available context and correlation properties.
property.reason: Preserve evidence for details and chains.
property.cost: Larger records; diagnostic values can be sensitive.

durationus.reason: Reduce recorded long-call/DB volume; keep errors and locks unfiltered.
durationus.cost: Short parents and aggregate cost of short DB calls can be hidden.

infobase.meaning: Exact p:processName filter on every branch.
infobase.reason: Restrict a server capture to the requested infobase.
infobase.cost: Excludes client/file events lacking that property.

plansql.cost: [doc] PostgreSQL methodology: test/development only. Older articles differ; plan generation can be expensive even with output filters.

dbmslocks.cost: Extra DBMS queries no more often than once every 2 seconds on DB access; not a complete deadlock graph.

mem.reason: Memory profile or requested MEM event.

leaks.meaning: Track retained objects at server point checkpoints.
leaks.reason: Memory profile or requested LEAKS event.
leaks.cost: Adds overhead; narrow to a procedure after localization.

scriptcircrefs.cost: Substantial performance loss; focused diagnostics only.
